scientific_target: Whether temporal occupancy and independently dated, directional first-arrival source identity jointly distinguish colonization history at matched metapopulation patches.

occupancy.name: Glanville annual patch occupancy and patch registry
occupancy.observational_target: survey-recorded annual colonization, not verified latent occupancy or confirmed origin

sibship.name: Fountain et al. family reconstruction of effective female dispersal
sibship.link_semantics: A reconstructed full-sib family found at two distinct patches supports that a female laid eggs in both locations; the two-patch observation does not reveal which patch she visited first.

published_prior_art.scope: Fountain et al. reconstructed across-patch full-sib families and effective female dispersal.
Austin et al. already examined size and genetic composition of colonizing propagules in this butterfly metapopulation.
Hanski et al. already modeled long-term population persistence and genotype-related colonization/extinction.
Annual patch occupancy already used by frozen EOG Glanville predictive validation.

formal_observation_equivalence.stated_observable: an unordered, same-maternal-family two-patch link {patch_A,patch_B} inferred from offspring sampled in the same yearly cohort
indistinguishable_histories: mother laid eggs in A then B
mother laid eggs in B then A
formal_observation_equivalence.caveat: External dated oviposition sequences, directed tracking, or qualified founder assignments could break the ambiguity, but this specific public abstract does not establish any.
formal_observation_equivalence.no_negative_claim: The genetic archive is not being asserted invalid: the source paper's effective-dispersal estimate remains scientifically meaningful.

longitudinal_overlap.note: Year 2012 is the preceding source year for 2012→2013; no 2013–2018 genetic observation evidence is advertised.

decision.narrowly_permitted_future_role: Possible retrospective, separately approved calibration or directional-connectivity sanity check, not first-origin identification or new independent EOG-WF predictive validation.
conditions_for_new_scoring: Independently verify Zenodo/Dryad archive member bytes and stable physical key schema without opening genotype/result rows.
Obtain an independent patch-ID concordance with the existing Åland patch registry and mark genetic sampling years explicitly.
Freeze whether sibling relations are undirected and forbid translating a dyad into earliest-source direction without additional independent timing or ancestry information.
Freeze a separate retrospective research question, original strong metapopulation baseline, any EOG added value and all STOP conditions before response access.
Do not describe a retrospective overlapping system as independent ecological replication of EOG v23 or the previously consumed Glanville predictor.
